text_block_list.name: BNW
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!

"That day, letting out a roar, the three sprinted forth.
Their goal was one and the same—1st place."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, I won't lose, I WON'T LOSE!!
Her relentless, insatiable hunger for victory stirs the hearts of all who watch—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The one who wins is MEEEEEEEE!!!
Everyone dreamed through that fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In 1st place, Winning Ticket!
1st place goes to Winning Ticket!!
(UWAAAAAAAHHH--!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: 1st place! It's 1st place! 1st plaaaaaaace!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...It's frustrating, but I lost.
You were really strong today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Still, I definitely won't lose next time...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A total defeat. That was a great run.
However, I won't yield next time. Absolutely not.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The next one to win will be me.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah, got it...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, when the two of you are in a race,
it gets a real fire burning deep inside me!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Those two are truly respectable Umamusume, special to me,
and my super, super important rivals.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So――let's keep doing our best together!
I won't lose next time, or the time after that, or the time after that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah... I accept the challenge. As many times as you like.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right... Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Ticket-zo won...
I'm so moved...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-zooo!!
Thank youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ti-cket-zoo!!
Ti-cket-zoo!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: W-Waaaaah...!!

Congratulatory words poured in one after another,
and the chants of "Ticket-zo!" echoed through the air.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (Everyone's eyes are sparkling...!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: (Everyone is so happy for me...!!)
Winning Ticket looked up at the stands and—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: THANK YOUUUUUUU!!

She beamed brightly,
flashing a smile as warm as the sun.
